summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fetches the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/*.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }`) and hex-mangled identifiers. The package advertises itself as `graphql config and checks` with a single documented CLI (`ornikar-check-graphql-prod-compat`); neither the README nor package.json documents fetching a second language runtime or executing a bundled binary blob at install time. Introducing an alien runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated shipped payload at preinstall causes arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
